node.statement: Now put c0=max{1,c_bar}. Then c0>=1 and, for every 0<=epsilon in lem-maincb-error-improvement, 0<=c_bar*epsilon<=c0*epsilon. Each supplied replacement has a finite-dimensional C*-algebra domain and the stated finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra codomain, so lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone upgrades it from an extended c_bar*epsilon-inclusion to an extended c0*epsilon-inclusion. Its bijectivity whenever the original map is bijective is unchanged. Thus c0 is a universal error-improvement witness satisfying c0>=1.
